purpose: Focused synthetic regression evidence for FCT09 HTML follow-up r2 findings F1-F3, plus the directly affected reviewer-transport fallback path.

target_identity.use: production job untouched; test cases use different synthetic job IDs

review_target.next_review: FC06 must address findings and provide a new exact manifest; a reviewer must independently assess that exact manifest. This source-level test evidence does not approve the HTML target.

pytest.common_flags: -B -m pytest -q <exact node> --basetemp <unique local directory> --junitxml=<unique FC07 file>
pytest.initial_data_scope: temporary MaintenanceStore SQLite or temporary attempt files only; no production DB, Daily, Scheduler, historical worker, queue/history, public remote or live AI

cases.expected: A second fallback reviewer response remains stored against the exact revised HTML path/hash/version that reviewer saw. If a distinct final fallback HTML is published, its review record is unavailable with no stale findings and binds only that final HTML.

initial.result: FAIL: test fixture did not inject the intended initial normal-author transport error; two additional normal-report role calls occurred before fallback.
initial.classification: test-fixture setup defect; product behavior was not measured by this run

rerun.expected_actual: 1 passed; author and two reviewer turns were invoked. The exact second-review response and input path/hash are retained in the immutable response sidecar. A separately rendered final fallback is pending/unavailable, has empty findings, and its review hash matches only its own output; the second-review hash is different.
rerun.database_counts: one synthetic job; one complete maintenance_report attempt; resume_count 0

cases.expected: With incident_id missing from raw manifest identity, fallback HTML and its fallback-input JSON persist under the existing safe job+attempt context; raw missing identity remains missing and the HTML explains the unknown.

initial.result: FAIL: the direct-call fixture did not create attempts_root. The recorded exception was MaintenanceAIBlockedError maintenance_write_root_invalid at _ensure_directories_beneath; this was a fixture environment defect, not identity persistence evidence.

rerun.expected_actual: 1 passed; substantive fallback HTML and maintenance-report-fallback-input-v1 were persisted under the same synthetic job/attempt; incident_id is absent from raw input identity and shown as missing in the HTML. The reviewer transport failure remained visible while the attempt was durably completed as a pending report.
rerun.database_counts: one synthetic job; one complete maintenance_report attempt; resume_count 0

cases.expected_actual: 1 passed; exact result.report_input path and SHA resolve the fallback-input schema/content under the same job+attempt, even when a lexically earlier decoy fallback file exists.

1 passed; _restore_completed_daily_report_context reads the synthetic completed result, passes its exact report_input path/hash to the resolver, and reads the matching maintenance-report-fallback-input-v1 artifact for that same attempt instead of the decoy. The completed job/attempt are synthetic resume-state records; attempt artifact content and digest are read from a normal temporary store path.
1 passed; transport failure produces a content-bearing pending/review_unavailable fallback and reaches the publication callback on the stable r2 source version.

validation.py_compile: PASS before the focused nodes; affected test file recompiled after fixture-only corrections by pytest import
validation.git_diff_check: PASS before final fixture-only correction; rerun required for final FC07 handoff

scope.next: FC08 product review and FC06 exact-manifest independent review remain separate; FCT09 stays changes_requested until a new exact manifest receives independent review. FC10/11 own the actual same-job execution and publication.
